subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff — paperwork, DPA & retention questions (BlueOak)
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <elena@blueoakhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueOak Procurement <procurement@blueoakhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood Inference — onboarding & DPA questions

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. We're ready to start the vendor onboarding process for BlueOak Health's integration with Redwood Inference. To keep procurement moving on our side, can you confirm the following so we can route the SOW/PO properly?

- Do you require a vendor-signed DPA or will you sign ours? If you prefer your template, could you share a draft?
- Please provide your vendor onboarding form or checklist we should complete (billing details, remit-to, tax info).
- Who should our procurement team send the PO to (email/contact)?
- Any standard lead times for PO processing and initial invoice?

For privacy/security details the security team asked for:
- Current list of subprocessors and the locations where data is hosted
- High-level retention defaults for logs and customer content
- Confirmation whether Redwood processes PHI or stores customer content unencrypted

I've attached our SOW (BlueOak_SOW_v1.pdf) for reference. If easier, we can schedule a short follow-up to walk through the paperwork.

Thanks,
Elena Gomez
Sr. Vendor Manager
BlueOak Health
elena@blueoakhealth.com

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — onboarding & DPA questions

Hi Elena — welcome, and thanks for sending the SOW. Looping in Marissa (Privacy) and Lauren (Procurement ops) to pick this up.

Quick answers and requests to help expedite:

- We generally sign a vendor DPA; attaching our standard DPA for convenience (see link below). Marissa will confirm any negotiation points.
- Please complete our vendor onboarding spreadsheet (redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx) and return with: remit-to, W-9 or local tax form, preferred PO contact/email, and any billing milestones.
- For the subprocessors/retention question — can you provide a simple CSV listing each subprocessor, its role, and hosting region? A short paragraph on retention defaults is fine if you keep it high-level.
- If BlueOak will be sending a PO, please indicate whether you require an invoice before start or if PO is sufficient to trigger provisioning. Our AP team aims to net-30 on standard POs.

I'm attaching: our vendor onboarding form (redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx) and a link to the DPA draft in Drive for quick access: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example-onboarding

If it's helpful, let's set a 30-minute call tomorrow to validate the form and SOW. What time zone is best for you?

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Manager, Vendor Programs
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Gomez <elena@blueoakhealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — onboarding & DPA questions

Thanks for the tag, Hannah. Hi Elena — I'm the privacy lead on vendor onboarding. A few specifics that will help our legal/privacy review and speed approval:

1) Data types: please confirm whether the integration will transmit or store any of the following: PHI, patient-identifiable information, raw customer content, or only hashed/derived telemetry.

2) Encryption and keys: confirm whether data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and whether you use a customer-managed KMS (if applicable). If you use a cloud KMS, tell us which provider and key region.

3) Subprocessors: please provide a table (CSV is fine) with: subprocessor name, purpose (analytics, logging, storage), country/region of processing, and a security contact email.

4) Retention: indicate default retention for logs, customer content, and backups. If you have different retention for EU/US data, call that out.

5) Certifications: attach any recent SOC 2 report or ISO certs, or provide portal links and dates of the latest audits.

I've uploaded a redlined DPA template to the Drive folder (redwood_dpa_draft.docx) — please review and return any redlines. Our preferred baseline is: encryption in transit+rest, subprocessors list and 30-day notice for new subprocessors, and a 90-day default log retention (unless otherwise negotiated).

If you prefer to send answers inline in an email, that's fine — just call out which question you're answering.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Privacy & Compliance
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_dpa_draft.docx (document)
From: Elena Gomez <elena@blueoakhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueOak Procurement <procurement@blueoakhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — onboarding & DPA questions

Marissa / Hannah,

Thanks — answers inline below and attaching a signed SOW for your records. Apologies for the long email; I wanted to be explicit so legal can move quickly.

1) Data types: We will only send pseudonymized customer identifiers and event metadata (no raw PHI, no patient-identifiable content). No file uploads or medical images.

2) Encryption and keys: Data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). We use AWS-managed KMS for now in us-east-1; we do not manage customer-supplied keys at this time.

3) Subprocessors: see list below (CSV attached as BlueOak_subprocessors.csv).

   - Amazon Web Services (storage, hosting) — us-east-1 — infra@aws.example
   - Google Cloud (analytics pipeline) — us-central1 — gc-support@google.example
   - Segment (data routing) — us-east-1 — support@segment.example
   - Sentry (error logging) — us-west-2 — security@sentry.example

4) Retention: Logs (application and debug logs): 90 days. Event metadata: 2 years. Backups: 1 year. Billing/invoices: 7 years. No regional differences today.

5) Certifications: We have a SOC 2 Type II report from 2025; attaching a link to the portal (https://vendor.blueoakhealth.com/soc2-report).

PO and billing: Our procurement contact is: BlueOak AP Team <ap@blueoakhealth.com>. We will issue a PO that references SOW #BO-2026-114. We typically require an invoice after provisioning; net-30 payment terms.

Attached: BlueOak_subprocessors.csv (text/csv), BlueOak_Signed_SOW.pdf (application/pdf)

Next steps: we'll complete Redwood's onboarding form (expect to send today) and return the DPA redlines if any. Let us know if you need us to sign a Redwood DPA or if your template is preferred.
